messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Announce: Distance 6.0 Release 2
parts:
Distance users,

I have just uploaded a second release of Distance 6.0 to the web site

http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/

Apologies for posting another release of Distance so soon after the last
one. Release 1 of D6 contained two bugs in the MRDS engine plotting
routines that prevented that engine from working well. They are listed
below. If you used the MRDS engine in Release 1, look in the Readme for
instructions about how to update the mrds library in R. Everything else
is the same as release 1.

Cheers to all,

- Len Thomas

Fixed bugs:
{366} Error message returned due to data selection problems when
plotting detection functions fit to interval data.
{367} Scaling of histograms for plotting ds model objects was incorrect.

--
Len Thomas, Co-ordinator, Distance Development Project
Research Unit for Wildlife Population Assessment
Centre for Research into Environmental and Ecological Modelling
The Observatory, University of St Andrews, Scotland KY16 9LZ

email: dist...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk
Distance home page: http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/
